user_input: My best friend and I promised we'd stay flatmates after college. But she got into a tier-1 firm and already has this new circle of 'high-package' friends. user_input: I look at my old school certificates and I honestly don't know who that kid was. I used to be the state board topper, the one everyone expected big things from.
